title: Dualizing complexes descend along a faithfully flat map of Noetherian rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that a complex over a Noetherian ring whose base change along a faithfully flat map of Noetherian rings is a dualizing complex over the target is itself a dualizing complex over the source (author lemma at source lines 5440-5446, label lemma-descent). The proof (source lines 5448-5474) descends boundedness and finiteness of the cohomology modules, base changes the derived internal hom against an arbitrary finite module to read off the vanishing range and hence finite injective dimension, and finally base changes the duality map into the internal hom of the complex with itself, where faithful flatness reflects the isomorphism (proof lines 5467-5473). The three descents are the substance. H3.
